headline: 雪國真相
brief:
# 網美小豬 EP2〈雪國〉

## 故事前提

粉粉在漫天大雪裡轉圈拍美照。拉遠：大太陽的頂樓，雪是刨冰被電風扇往上吹；水豚男友頂著刨冰機站在電風扇後面，凍到眉毛結霜。她重擺姿勢，水豚打了一個噴嚏，整片冰屑噴了她一身。

## 角色

- 粉粉（fenfen）、水豚男友（capy）：同系列定裝照；這集粉粉換白色毛帽與白色毛衣。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；系列公式：唯美 → 閃光一瞄 → 拉遠揭曉 → 男友 → 成品照破綻 → 重擺被整。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 16 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：雪國
一行說明：雪中轉圈 → 閃光一瞄 → 頂樓刨冰 → 結霜的男友 → 成品照 → 噴嚏噴她一身冰。
開場鉤子：大雪裡，有一片雪往上飛。

shots.ff: Close-up of Fenfen the pink pig herself in a white fluffy knitted beanie and a white wool sweater, a dreamy profile smile, thick snowflakes falling all around her in soft focus, a snowy pine forest behind; one snowflake near the corner is flying upward.
shots.clip: The pink pig shown in <Picture 1> slowly spins once in the falling snow with a dreamy smile; thick snowflakes drift down, but a few in the corner fly straight upward. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium close-up of Fenfen the pink pig herself in a white beanie and white sweater, frozen in a dreamy profile pose, snowflakes around her.
shots.clip: A bright camera flash fires once; the pink pig shown in <Picture 1> keeps her face frozen and only her eyes slowly slide to the lower right; one eyebrow twitches. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Wide shot of a sun-baked concrete rooftop in Taiwan on a blazing hot summer day, water tanks and laundry in the background: Fenfen the pink pig herself in her white beanie and sweater poses in the middle, sweating; a big electric fan at the right edge blows a stream of shaved ice upward around her like snow; a plastic kiddie pool full of melting ice at her feet.
shots.clip: The pink pig shown in <Picture 1> holds her dreamy pose while sweating; the fan at the right blows streams of shaved ice up and around her; the shaved ice melts on the hot concrete. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot on the sunny rooftop of the capybara boyfriend himself standing behind a big electric fan, holding a hand-cranked shaved-ice machine above the fan with both paws, his face, eyebrows and whiskers frosted white with ice crystals, completely deadpan.
shots.clip: The capybara shown in <Picture 1> cranks the shaved-ice machine steadily above the spinning fan, shaved ice blowing away; his frosted eyebrows twitch; his deadpan face does not change. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: The finished photo filling the vertical frame with a thin white photo border: Fenfen the pink pig in a white beanie and sweater in a magical snowy pine forest, picture perfect like a magazine cover; peeking from behind a snowy pine tree in the background is a frosted capybara face in a green bucket hat.
shots.clip: The photo shown in <Picture 1> holds still; the frosted capybara face behind the pine tree slowly blinks once. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

shots.ff: Medium shot on the sunny rooftop of Fenfen the pink pig herself in her white beanie and sweater, taking her dreamy profile pose again.
shots.clip: The pink pig shown in <Picture 1> takes her dreamy pose; suddenly a huge burst of shaved ice blasts into her from the right side of the frame and covers her completely in white ice; she stays frozen in the pose, smile unchanged, ice sliding off her nose. The camera holds a static shot.
